newsitem.title: NORWAY: Blue chips drag down Oslo Total index.
newsitem.headline: Blue chips drag down Oslo Total index.

text.p: Blue chips such as Norsk Hydro fell on Tuesday to burden the Oslo Total index, which slipped 0.85 percent to close at 869.45 points.
Turnover was a thin 521 million crowns on what several dealers said was a boring day.
"Hydro dragged down the Total index and so did the entire shipping segment led by Bergesen. Some other heavy shares, such as Elkem and Nycomed, also fell," one dealer said.
Industrial conglomerate Hydro fell 0.5 percent to 297.50 and shipping group Bergesen's A share slipped 1.7 percent to 142 crowns.
Metals producer Elkem's A share fell 3.8 percent to 88 crowns and pharmaceutical group Nycomed A dropped 2.9 percent to 82.50 crowns.
